measurement_policies.line_policy: physical nonblank code-bearing lines; comments and mixed lines counted separately; Python docstrings are literals
measurement_policies.cc_policy: E-N+2P on reachable normal-flow CFG; short-circuit conditions expanded; unsupported flow -> null
measurement_policies.npath_policy: node-simple entry-exit paths; NOT asserted identical to original Nejmeh implementation
measurement_policies.mi_policy: P9 Table 2 literal: sqrt(246*COM); natural logarithms; no clipping
measurement_policies.default_visibility_policy: Java/Smali package/default access, NOT Java interface default keyword; unavailable for Python
measurement_policies.association_policy: No source-level association inference; supply UML/normalized design model
measurement_policies.coupling_policy: Symmetric union of resolved declared-type uses and calls; inheritance-only edges excluded
measurement_policies.callgraph_policy: Conservative syntactic static targets; *_resolved counts exclude ambiguous calls; no runtime dispatch claim
measurement_policies.class_count_policy: Named classes including enums/records; interfaces counted separately

project.scope: successfully_measured_subset; inspect coverage before comparing repositories

call_graph.scope: Named declarations in analyzed snapshot; syntactic resolution, not runtime dispatch

api_usage.scope: Matched static invocation sites, not dynamic execution counts
api_usage.note: Registry is user-supplied; the AndroMetric PDF does not publish its exact API mapping

unavailable_or_external_input_metrics.reason: No formal knot algorithm/ordering is defined in the supplied paper.
Scope membership and global/local parameter definitions are insufficient. Raw E_j and NEW_1 arithmetic are implemented for supplied inputs.
Named or ambiguously labeled dataset fields; formulas/extractor specification are absent. B is NOT automatically treated as observed bug count.
Only names/representative columns are supplied; exact definitions/schema are not reconstructed.
Scoring rules/thresholds/measurement windows are incomplete. No substitute Git heuristics are presented as these scores.
Vendor/business inputs must be supplied. Health and ROCR arithmetic are implemented.
P5 does not specify matching/interpolation/confidence rules. Supply per-class AP at each IoU threshold.
Candidate names in P9, without sufficient operational definitions in its implementation table.
Variants/extractor conventions unspecified; do not substitute a different metric silently.

detection.input_requirement: AP values from a separately configured detection evaluator

runtime.gpu_memory_note: Observed telemetry samples; not automatically a device-wide peak

citations.note: Deduplicate cross-provider work IDs before input

hybrid.note: Scope membership/adjusted values are supplied, not inferred from source

design_model_metrics.policy: Explicit model relations only; return parameters excluded; inherited members deduplicated by signature/name
